fever._note: GDD 8.3. Rates sit at the slow end of the sanctioned ranges (distance 0.03~0.07, coin 0.8~1.6): at the defaults the gauge filled in ~45s, under the 50~70s target, because a coin-heavy line charges far faster than the distance-only sanity check in 8.3 assumes. ~68s now. durationSec 5.0 -> 7.5 (GDD 8.3 revision, user request): five seconds ended before the payoff registered. Tune from measured per-minute distance/coins/near-miss, never by hardcoding elsewhere.

items._note: Item table (user spec 2026-08-13). placement: risk = near a hazard so the pickup costs a manoeuvre; safe = in a clear stretch; neutral = anywhere. Weights give bigcoin/magnet/bolt 'medium' frequency and shield 'low'.
